tools.description: Analyze images with a dedicated visual model — the right choice when the current model cannot view images itself, or when a tuned analysis prompt helps (PNG/JPG/screenshots/diagrams/charts). Pick the matching `action` for a tuned prompt; if no action fits, use `general-image` with `extra_prompt`. Multimodal models may simply Read the image when direct viewing suffices. Image-ONLY.

action.description: general-image: describe any image, transcribe text first. ui-to-artifact: convert UI screenshot to self-contained HTML. diagram-analysis: extract nodes, edges, and hierarchy from an architecture or flowchart diagram; output Mermaid if the diagram admits it. data-viz: extract axes, data points, and trend from a quantitative chart. error-diagnosis: classify the error in a screenshot and suggest a fix. ui-diff: compare a design mockup against its implementation screenshot. paper-figure: write a publication-ready figure analysis paragraph giving a complete analysis of the figure from an academic perspective.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. 'auto' (default) uses each action's tuned preset.

extra_prompt.description: Optional additional user instructions appended to the analysis prompt. Use this to customize any action — e.g., for paper-figure, paste the figure contract and paper background here; for general-image, specify what to focus on.

image.description: Image: file path or http(s) URL.

model.description: Model tier. 'auto' (default) uses each action's tuned preset — pro for high-value reasoning (ui-to-artifact, diagram-analysis, data-viz, paper-figure), std for routine tasks (general-image, error-diagnosis, ui-diff). Override only when you have a specific reason.

tools.name: visual_analyze_image
